d:
Marine Le Pen sits down for an exclusive interview on some of the biggest political and social questions facing France and Europe.
In a wide-ranging conversation, she speaks about protests in France and across Europe, immigration and labour shortages, Islam and French values, and Donald Trump’s claim that Paris is becoming a Muslim city.
Le Pen also discusses France’s relationship with India, New Delhi’s strategic autonomy and its engagement with Russia. She also reflects on France’s political future — including why the country has never elected a woman president.
